desc: Pistol Caliber Carbine is an extremely fun division in the action shooting sports such as 3-gun and USPSA. The Anderson AM9 is an affordable option for anyone wanting to compete in PCC. Compact and lightweight the AM9 is a soft-shooting PCC in the AR pattern. Add the optic of your choice to the full-length Picatinny rail and you are ready to go. The AM9 is also perfectly suited for use as a home defense carbine and makes a great companion carbine for a pistol that uses Glock style magazines.
